Annual exam

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Andrea is a 52-year-old female with past medical history significant for rheumatoid arthritis, atrial fibrillation, and reflux presenting for her annual exam. She reports good compliance with exercise regimen including walking and yoga, which has significantly improved her arthritis symptoms. She denies joint pain, stiffness, or flare-ups over the past year. She reports an event monitor was performed last month. Regarding her reflux, she has made dietary modifications by eliminating soda and reports no flare-ups in over five months. She denies chest pain, shortness of breath, or nausea and vomiting.
